\left\lceil \frac{17}{7} - \left\lceil \frac{27}{17} \right\rceil \right\rceil
\]

First, \(\frac{27}{17} \approx 1.588\), so \(\left\lceil \frac{27}{17} \right\rceil = 2\).

Then:

\[
\frac{17}{7} - 2 = \frac{17}{7} - \frac{14}{7} = \frac{3}{7} \approx 0.4286
\]

Ceiling of \(\frac{3}{7}\) is \(1\). So numerator = \(1\).

Denominator:

\[
\left\lceil \frac{27}{7} + \left\lceil \frac{7\cdot 17}{27} \right\rceil \right\rceil
\]

First, \(\frac{119}{27} \approx 4.407\), so ceiling is \(5\).

Then:

\[
\frac{27}{7} + 5 = \frac{27}{7} + \frac{35}{7} = \frac{62}{7} \approx 8.857
\]

Ceiling of \(\frac{62}{7}\) is \(9\). So denominator = \(9\).

Thus the fraction is:

\[
\frac{1}{9}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{1}{9}\).
